newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai 1997 rice export quota to EU at 64,867 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Thai 1997 rice export quota to EU at 64,867 tonnes.

text.p: Thailand's rice export quota to the European Union for 1997 will be 64,867 tonnes compared with 21,455 tonnes this year, a commerce ministry official said on Monday.
The quota included 21,455 tonnes of 100 percent grade fragrant and parboiled rice, 41,600 tonnes of broken rice and 1,812 tonnes of cargo rice.
The shipment periods will be divided into four -- January, April, July and September, she said.
The government will export 60 percent of the quota and private exporters 40 percent, the official said. --Bangkok newsroom (662) 652-0642
